property_summary: The transfer function always returns true when it does not revert.
The transfer function returns true when called by the authorized sender.
The transfer function returns a value equal to true when it does not revert, as per the reference contract always returning true.
The transfer function returns true when all parameters are valid and the caller is authorized.
When the transfer function does not revert, it always returns true.
The amount transferred to each recipient must be at least the original v[i] scaled by 10^18.
For each call to transfer(address[],uint256[]), the total value transferred to all recipients must be exactly the sum of v[i] multiplied by 10^18.
After a call to transfer, the sum of transferred amounts (in wei) across all recipients equals the sum of v[i] * 10^18.
After a call to transfer with length n, the sum of the amounts sent (via caddress.call) must be exactly 10^18 times the sum of v[i].
Each amount transferred via caddress.call must be exactly v[i] * 10^18 wei.
